title: Riot Squad BLCK EDTN Mango Vanilla Ice Cream 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid 2 Pack
description: This Pack Contains x2 50ml Shortfills Mango Vanilla Ice Cream from Riot Squad’s premium Black Edition shortfill range is a dreamy, decadent dessert vape that blends fresh, ripe, juicy mangoes with rich Madagascan vanilla in a silky smooth ice cream. This pack contains two 50ml nicotine-free shortfill bottles and both bottles come with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your exact liking. Their 70VG/30PG ratio makes them ideal for high-powered sub-ohm tanks and mods.
